svg.title: The GP3 pipeline
svg.desc: A block diagram of the GP3 pipeline in two rows. Top row, left to right: a gray box Factory state (topics, records); a white box Selection (which cell, which slot) with tag 1; a white box Generator (writes problem.pddl) with tag 2; a white box Planner (Fast Downward) with tag 3, which also takes an arrow from a gray box Domain (fixed file) on its right. An arrow goes down from the planner to a gray box Plan (ordered steps). Bottom row, right to left: Plan, a white box Plan-to-BT (one subtree a step) with tag 4, a white box Behavior tree (calls the skills), and a white box Factory (ARIAC). An arrow goes up from the factory to Factory state, closing the loop.
